+class _SearchPathMonitor:
+    """Poll the search paths of a :class:`FileSystemLoader` on a
+    background thread and tell the loader which files were added,
+    changed or removed.
+
+    Polling behaves the same on every platform and needs no extra
+    dependency. The thread only holds a weak reference to the loader, so
+    it never keeps the loader alive. It ends when the loader is
+    collected and while no environment uses the loader; the next
+    environment to load a template starts it again.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, owner: "FileSystemLoader", interval: float) -> None:
+        self._owner = weakref.ref(owner)
+        self._interval = interval
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
+        self._stopped = threading.Event()
+        self._running = False
+        self._pid = os.getpid()
+        self._snapshot: t.Dict[str, t.Tuple[int, int]] = {}
+
+    def ensure_running(self, owner: "FileSystemLoader") -> None:
+        with self._lock:
+            # a forked child has the flag but not the thread
+            if self._running and self._pid == os.getpid():
+                return
+
+            self._pid = os.getpid()
+            self._snapshot = self._scan(owner)
+            self._running = True
+            thread = threading.Thread(
+                target=self._run, name="jinja2-template-monitor", daemon=True
+            )
+            thread.start()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        self._stopped.set()
+
+    def _run(self) -> None:
+        while not self._stopped.wait(self._interval):
+            if not self._tick():
+                return
+
+    def _tick(self) -> bool:
+        # The loader is a local of this method so it is not kept alive
+        # while the thread sleeps between two polls.
+        owner = self._owner()
+
+        with self._lock:
+            if owner is None or not owner._environments:
+                self._running = False
+                return False
+
+        try:
+            changed = self._poll(owner)
+
+            if changed:
+                owner._on_template_changed(changed)
+        except Exception:
+            # A failed poll must not end the monitoring, the next one
+            # starts from the last snapshot that was read.
+            pass
+
+        return True
+
+    def _poll(self, owner: "FileSystemLoader") -> t.List[str]:
+        current = self._scan(owner)
+        previous, self._snapshot = self._snapshot, current
+        changed = [p for p, sig in current.items() if previous.get(p) != sig]
+        changed.extend(p for p in previous if p not in current)
+        return changed

+        """Map the path of every file in the search paths to its
+        modification time and size.
+        """
+        found = {}
+
+        for searchpath in list(owner.searchpath):
+            root = os.path.abspath(searchpath)
+            walk_dir = os.walk(root, followlinks=owner.followlinks)

+                    except OSError:
+                        # removed since the directory was listed
+                        continue

+                    found[filepath] = (stat.st_mtime_ns, stat.st_size)
+
+        return found
